convention: Per-neighborhood prime commercial streets and local spend. Keyed citySlug.neighborhoodSlug. prime_streets[].rent_vs_city and spend_per_visit_usd are optional and self-omit when absent (the pipeline fills them).

prime_streets.name: Fifth Avenue
prime_streets.sells: Luxury flagship retail: Tiffany, Bergdorf Goodman, Saks, the Apple Cube. Among the most expensive retail frontage in the world.

prime_streets.name: Times Square and Broadway
prime_streets.sells: Destination retail at scale plus the theater district: flagship stores, entertainment, and the Broadway houses.

prime_streets.name: Garment District
prime_streets.sells: The wholesale back-end of US fashion: fabric and trim suppliers, showrooms, and sample-makers around Seventh Avenue.

prime_streets.name: Diamond District
prime_streets.sells: One of the most concentrated jewelry markets in the world, retail and wholesale, along 47th Street.

new-york.manhattan-midtown.notes: Seeded from the curated New York commercial-streets set, re-homed to Midtown. Per-street rent and spend-per-visit await the pipeline.
